messages:
Evan (Billing): Flagging an issue from the nightly invoice run: promotional credits plus proration caused VAT to be applied twice on some EU invoices; a few ended up with negative net totals.
Tom (Eng): Which job and any log examples?
Evan (Billing): job invoice-batch-2026-03-23-02. Log excerpt:
```
invoice_lines:
  - promo_credit: -75.00
  - prorated_subscription: 75.00
  - vat: 0.00
  - VAT: 15.00
```
Evan (Billing): Note the tax lines differ in case (vat vs VAT) in the pipeline; downstream dedupe missed case-insensitive matches.
Chloe (Tax): Oh interesting. Our tax-service returns normalized codes but the billing pipeline canonicalizes later; race + case mismatch could dup tax lines.
ops-bot: invoice-batch-2026-03-23-02 finished: 31 warnings, 7 errors. Errors: TAX_DUPLICATE_CASE, EXPORT_BLOCKED_NEG_TOTAL.
Ivy (Payments): Stripe will likely reject negative totals. Recommend pausing export for that batch until reconciled.
Tom (Eng): I can implement a fast fix: case-insensitive dedupe of tax_code and a final check preventing export of negative-balance invoices. Will open PR for the exporter guard.
Evan (Billing): Please hold exports. Finance will not send statements until we confirm corrected totals. Also need list of affected customers and invoices for customer comms.
Chloe (Tax): Long-term: enforce canonical tax codes at the tax-service output and add normalization tests. Short-term: dedupe by lowercased tax_code and assert total==sum(lines)+sum(taxes).
Ivy (Payments): After fix, we can re-run exports for only impacted invoices. Stripe idempotency keys exist but drafts may need manual cleanup.
Tom (Eng): ETA for guard: ~1.5 hours. Full fix and tests tomorrow morning. Will add canary.
Evan (Billing): I'll assemble CSV of affected invoice ids and owners and post to #sales-ops. Target customer notification within 24h, remediation complete in 48h.
Chloe (Tax): Also check for other tax code variants (e.g., VAT_EU) in historical runs.
Evan (Billing): Thanks team. Holding exports now. Will share the customer message draft in ~90 mins. :beetle:
